description.zh:
媒资ID，即视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the video. You can obtain the media ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Library** > **Audio/Video** to view the media ID of a video uploaded through the console.

- If you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain an upload URL and credentials, the media ID is returned as the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.

- After a video is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the media ID. The media ID is returned as the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.

description.zh: 工作流ID。可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**配置管理** > **媒体处理配置** > **工作流管理**查看ID。
description.en: The workflow ID. Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Configuration** > **Media Processing** > **Workflows** to view the ID.

descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解视频点播产品的收费方式和价格。使用工作流过程中，可能涉及产生转码、加密、智能审核等费用，计费详情，请参见[视频点播计费概述](~~188307~~)。**
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027551~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[获取任务详情](~~2861326~~)主动查询任务状态。
- 调用本接口，可对视频发起工作流处理任务。有关工作流的更多内容，请参见[工作流](~~115347~~)。
descriptions.en:
- **Important: Before you call this operation, understand the billing methods and pricing of ApsaraVideo VOD. Using a workflow may incur fees for features such as transcoding, encryption, and content moderation. For more information, see [ApsaraVideo VOD pricing](~~188307~~).**

- This operation is an [asynchronous API](~~3027551~~). After you submit the job, the API returns a task ID. The job is queued and runs asynchronously. The service delivers the final result through a callback. You can also query the task status by calling [GetTask](~~2861326~~).

- Use this operation to submit a workflow job for a video. For more information about workflows, see [Workflows](~~115347~~).
